The [[Deldrimor Staff]] was introduced in the [[Game updates/20080424|April 24, 2008 game update]] and is part of the Deldrimor set. It is available for any caster attribute. It is inscribable. 

==Acquisition==
Crafted by [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]] for: 10 {{plat}}, 10 {{Deldrimor Steel}}, and 10 {{steel}}.

== Stats ==
:<[[Damage type|Type]]> damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 <[[attribute]]>)
:[[Energy]] +10
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Inscription]]: None

==Dye==
[[Dye]] affects both the gem in the head of the staff and the wrapping at the base of the staff. The default colour can be closely replicated with brown dye.
